brief:
Israeli occupation forces have escalated military operations in southern Syria, Shehab Wire reported, with advancing troops now threatening villages and towns near the demarcation line in Quneitra and Daraa provinces. The movements represent an ongoing violation of Syrian sovereignty, according to the report.

The incursions mark a continued pattern of Israeli military activity in the border region, which separates Israeli-controlled territory from Syrian-held areas. The escalating operations target settlements in close proximity to the separation line dividing the two provinces.

title: Israeli forces deepen incursions into Quneitra and Daraa
